camdrones.autonomy.status.mission_paused: %1$s: mission paused, the drone holds its position
camdrones.autonomy.status.hold_started: %1$s holds its position without a pilot
camdrones.autonomy.status.relayed: %1$s: command passed on to the pilot
camdrones.autonomy.status.no_budget: %1$s: no budget for a flight without pilot (world rules “Autonomous flights per player at once” and “Autonomous flights in total”)
camdrones.autonomy.status.piloted: %1$s is being flown by a pilot
camdrones.autonomy.status.piloted.fpv: %1$s is an FPV drone and is being flown – it flies missions only without a pilot: take off the goggles, then Start
camdrones.autonomy.status.not_ready: %1$s is not ready for a flight without pilot
camdrones.autonomy.status.not_ready.gps: %1$s has no GPS fix – flights without pilot need a clear view of the sky
camdrones.autonomy.status.not_ready.batt: %1$s: battery too low for a flight without pilot (at least 15 %% for the way home) – charge it first
camdrones.autonomy.status.not_ready.not_: %1$s is not resting on the ground – let it land, then press Start
camdrones.autonomy.status.not_ready.no_t: %1$s stands on the ground, but the flight came without a take-off – press Start again
camdrones.autonomy.status.not_ready.no_b: %1$s has no battery for a flight without pilot
camdrones.autonomy.status.not_ready.remo: %1$s is gone – picked up or destroyed
camdrones.autonomy.status.not_armable.no: %1$s cannot be armed: no battery fitted
camdrones.autonomy.status.not_armable.ba: %1$s cannot be armed: the battery is empty – charge it first
camdrones.autonomy.status.disabled: Autonomous flights are switched off on this server (world rule “Allow autonomous flights”)
camdrones.autonomy.status.busy: %1$s is already in another flight without pilot
camdrones.autonomy.status.no_mission: %1$s has no mission – send one from the flight planner first
camdrones.autonomy.status.not_found: Drone %1$s not found (paired with the flight planner and loaded?)
camdrones.autonomy.status.ambiguous: Several drones match – give a name or serial number
camdrones.autonomy.status.too_fast: Too many commands – wait a moment
camdrones.autonomy.status.ended_battery: %1$s: battery low – flight without pilot ended, returning home or landing
camdrones.autonomy.status.ended_owner_of: %1$s: owner offline – flight without pilot ended
camdrones.autonomy.status.ended_out_of_r: %1$s: out of radio range – returning home or landing
camdrones.autonomy.status.ended_timeout: %1$s: autonomous flight time limit reached – returning home or landing
camdrones.autonomy.status.ended_error: %1$s: flight assist error – landing on the spot
camdrones.autonomy.status.ended_replaced: %1$s: flight replaced by another flight without pilot
camdrones.autonomy.status.ended_terrain_: %1$s: world edge reached – drones may not generate new terrain here, returning home or landing
camdrones.autonomy.status.follow_request: Asked %2$s for consent – %1$s waits for the answer
camdrones.autonomy.status.follow_decline: %2$s does not want to be followed
camdrones.autonomy.status.follow_rule_of: Following other players is switched off on this server (world rule)
camdrones.autonomy.status.follow_not_all: %1$s may only follow you, your own animals or your mount, and other players riding along must have agreed
camdrones.autonomy.status.follow_target_: %1$s lost its target and holds its position
camdrones.autonomy.status.follow_stopped: %2$s ended being followed – %1$s holds its position
camdrones.autonomy.status.follow_no_requ: There is no open request to follow you
camdrones.autonomy.status.consent_given: You allowed %2$s to follow you with a camera drone. End it any time with /camdrones follow stop
camdrones.autonomy.status.auto_shot_done: %1$s: auto flight finished, the drone holds its position
camdrones.autonomy.consent.chat: %1$s wants to follow you with the camera drone %2$s (%3$s s): %4$s %5$s
camdrones.autonomy.consent.accept.hint: The drone follows you. End it any time with /camdrones follow stop
camdrones.autonomy.consent.deny.hint: The drone will not follow you
camdrones.autonomy.consent.title: Follow me
camdrones.autonomy.consent.question: %1$s wants to follow you with the camera drone %2$s. While it follows, you see who it is and can end it any time with /camdrones follow stop. The request expires in %3$s s.
camdrones.autonomy.followed: %1$s follows you with the camera drone %2$s – stop: /camdrones follow stop
camdrones.command.drone.none: No paired camera drone found – pair one with the flight planner or give its name
camdrones.command.drone.ambiguous: Several drones match: %s – give a name or serial number
camdrones.command.list.none: No paired camera drones are loaded
